terms.comment: An ordinary description, the curtain’s ring; plural ānulī aulaeī. Traupman and Morgan–Owens have words for the curtain (aulaeum, vēlum, Traupman 123, 300; cortīna, M-O s.v. curtain) but none for its fittings.

phrases.english: Put the rings onto the rod.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 123, 300.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. curtain.
